purpose: Targeted directional-master camera and paint fidelity repair
method: First-party image_gen edit; identity seed plus previous sheet
prompt:
Use the FIRST image as the authoritative identity, camera elevation and painted treatment. The SECOND image is the eight-view candidate to repair, not a new design authority. Edit that coordinated sheet, preserving its correct costume construction, eight-view positions, silver hair, gold cape, bronze armour, ivory split tunic, teal accents, narrow sword and anatomical RIGHT handedness.
Two targeted corrections throughout all eight views: (1) raise the camera to precisely match the first seed's elevated gameplay view, approximately 45 degrees DOWN at the character. Use the reference's looking-down, mostly fringe-hidden face rather than large full-front anime eyes. Side views must also be viewed from above. Bottom: N (back), NE (back toward viewer right), E (right profile), SE (front toward viewer right). Independently authored directions, NO mirroring. Equal apparent body size and shared elevation in all cells. Stable gold cape fastening/length and weapon dimensions. Neutral upright ready pose. Anatomical right hand owns sword: viewer-left on front, viewer-right on back. Do not change hands, add a shield, helmet or jewellery, redesign the face, change age or body proportions, turn the clothes into plate mail, or alter the weapon. Preserve everything else that already matches the reference.
Pure transparent background, no floor or external shadow, no labels or scenery. Return only the revised painted 2D sprite master sheet. No 3D/PBR/plastic rendering, no portrait camera, no generic fantasy redesign.
